system_prompt: You are a structural biologist studying drug resistance. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Add a methyl group to the nitrogen to enhance steric hindrance and reduce enzymatic degradation.
modifications.rationale: The methyl group increases steric hindrance near the nitrogen, potentially reducing the action of enzymes that confer resistance by modifying this site.

modifications.description: Replace one chloroethyl group with a bromoethyl group to increase alkylation reactivity.
modifications.rationale: Bromoethyl groups are more reactive alkylating agents, which may help overcome resistance by targeting DNA more effectively.

modifications.description: Incorporate a fluorine atom into the aromatic ring to modulate electronic properties.
modifications.rationale: The fluorine atom can alter the electronic environment, potentially improving binding affinity to drug-resistant variants of DNA.
